about: Cycle Gear operates a chain of motorcycle gear and accessories retail stores headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company runs over 170 locations across the United States. The retailer stocks over 100,000 products including helmets, riding apparel, boots, gloves, parts, tires, and accessories for motorcycles, UTVs, and ATVs. Stores offer in-person customer support, free ship-to-store pickup, and installation services such as tire mounting and Bluetooth communicator setup. Each location also hosts community events like bike nights. Cycle Gear serves street, cruiser, dirt, adventure, and touring riders, as well as UTV and ATV owners. The inventory features brands such as Shoei, Arai, AGV, Bell, Scorpion, HJC, Icon, Alpinestars, and its own SEDICI label. The RPM membership program provides cash-back rewards and referral discounts to frequent shoppers.
